title: Listing Highlight: 86' Bugari Flybridge 2021 | SEDA
description: Discover the 2021 Bugari Flybridge—a sophisticated 60+ foot charter yacht combining Italian design with modern amenities for unforgettable coastal experiences.
html:
A Contemporary Flybridge Yacht Designed For Charter Excellence And Refined Entertaining

The 2021 Bugari Flybridge represents a masterclass in contemporary yacht design, seamlessly blending European sophistication with the practical demands of modern charter operations. This vessel stands as a testament to the enduring appeal of well-proportioned flybridge yachts, offering owners and charter guests alike an exceptional platform for exploration and entertainment along some of the world’s most coveted coastlines.

Bugari’s design philosophy centers on creating vessels that maximize usable space while maintaining elegant proportions and intuitive layouts. The Flybridge model exemplifies this approach, with its signature raised helm station providing commanding visibility and a commanding presence on the water. The flybridge itself serves as an extended social hub, complete with comfortable seating arrangements and unobstructed sightlines that transform every voyage into an immersive experience. Below deck, the accommodations reflect a commitment to comfort and style that appeals to discerning travelers. The main saloon features generous proportions with large windows that flood the interior with natural light, creating an airy atmosphere that belies the vessel’s substantial size. The galley is thoughtfully appointed with modern appliances and ample counter space, enabling both professional provisioning and casual meal preparation. Multiple staterooms provide flexible accommodation options, each designed with attention to detail and finished in warm, inviting materials.

The master suite commands particular attention, offering a private retreat with an ensuite head and generous storage solutions. Guest cabins are similarly well-appointed, ensuring that every member of the party enjoys comfort and privacy. The crew quarters, positioned forward, provide dedicated space for professional staff to operate efficiently without compromising guest privacy or the vessel’s overall flow. From a technical standpoint, the 2021 Bugari Flybridge incorporates systems and specifications that support both extended cruising and active charter deployment. The vessel’s construction utilizes modern materials and building techniques that balance durability with weight efficiency. Twin diesel engines provide reliable propulsion with economical fuel consumption characteristics, while comprehensive navigation and communication systems ensure safe passage in all conditions.

The yacht’s exterior spaces are designed for maximum enjoyment and functionality. The aft deck provides a natural gathering area with easy access to the water, ideal for swimming, water sports, or simply enjoying the surrounding seascape. The foredeck offers additional lounging opportunities and serves as a practical working area for anchoring and mooring operations. Throughout, non-skid surfaces and substantial railings prioritize safety without compromising aesthetic appeal. For charter operators, the 2021 Bugari Flybridge delivers proven appeal to a broad market segment. The flybridge configuration attracts guests seeking elevated outdoor experiences, while the spacious interior accommodations and well-equipped galley support multi-week itineraries. The vessel’s size and capability enable deployment across diverse cruising grounds, from Mediterranean classics to Caribbean exploration, making it a versatile asset for charter fleets.

The yacht’s systems reflect contemporary standards in marine engineering. Climate control throughout the vessel ensures comfort in varying conditions, while water and fuel capacities support extended passages between provisioning stops. The electrical systems incorporate modern battery technology and charging infrastructure, supporting both traditional diesel generation and emerging hybrid solutions. Comprehensive through-hull fittings and seacocks are strategically positioned and properly valved for safety and operational efficiency. Maintenance and serviceability have been considered throughout the design and construction process. Engine room access is logical and comprehensive, with major systems positioned for straightforward inspection and service. Spare parts availability through established Bugari networks ensures that routine maintenance and unexpected repairs can be addressed promptly, minimizing downtime and supporting reliable operations.

The 2021 Bugari Flybridge exemplifies the enduring appeal of well-executed yacht design. Whether deployed for private exploration or professional charter service, this vessel delivers the combination of performance, comfort, and style that defines contemporary luxury cruising. The thoughtful integration of functional systems with refined aesthetics creates an environment where guests naturally gravitate toward extended time aboard, whether engaged in active water sports or simply savoring the contemplative pleasures of life at sea. For those seeking a charter-ready vessel that commands respect in any anchorage while delivering exceptional guest experiences, the 2021 Bugari Flybridge merits serious consideration.
